app.title: DocValidate
app.subtitle: Institutional Document Scrutiny & Validation System
app.banner: Prototype using synthetic data. Scores and thresholds are illustrative; officers make all decisions.

roles.demoAuthNote: Demo authentication only - select persona for prototype evaluation.

help.verifiedDesc: All deterministic checks passed with high OCR confidence, matching metadata, valid cross-document linkages, and authentic registry records.
help.needsVerificationDesc: A document has minor low OCR confidence, unreadable QR code, scan blur/noise, or missing fields that require human officer review. This is NOT a rejection.
help.inconsistentDesc: Information between two submitted documents conflicts (e.g. land ownership name differs from sponsoring trust entity name, or dates appear in reverse chronological order).
help.possibleTamperingDesc: Algorithmic image forensics detected localized compression anomalies (ELA), cloned pixel patterns, noise variations, or editing software metadata. These are probability signals for human scrutiny, not proof of fraud.

documents.title: Mandatory Approval Documents
documents.uploadHint: Upload PDF or high-resolution PNG/JPG scans up to 25MB
documents.unrecognizedNotice: This file type was not automatically recognized. A scrutiny officer will review it manually during official inspection.
documents.dragDrop: Drag & drop file here or click to browse

preCheck.title: Pre-submission Validation Check
preCheck.disclaimer: This pre-submission check runs safe deterministic rules and cross-checks without officially submitting your application.
preCheck.noIssues: No issues found! Your application meets all mandatory automated checks.

submit.title: Official Application Submission
submit.summary: Review application summary before official submission to AICTE Scrutiny Officers.
submit.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to submit this application for official officer review? Once submitted, the application enters the officer scrutiny queue.

feedback.title: Deficiency Report
feedback.empty: No deficiencies found. Application is in good standing.

fix.title: Fix Deficiencies & Run Recheck
fix.resubmitNotice: Recheck completed. You may now submit your corrected application.
